metadata.title: Jason's Journey
metadata.description: Jason is determined to stay sober, but that isn't always easy for a high school athlete.

scene_001.title: Morning
scene_001.narration: You wake up to your alarm, irritated by its very existence.

choices.label: Get out of bed

resource_link.description: Feeling irritable, grouchy, or upset is a common symptom of withdrawal, best not to wallow.

choices.label: Hit the Snooze Button and Go Back to Sleep

resource_link.description: Zzzz.

choices.label: Check your Phone

resource_link.description: You check your phone to see pictures from a party you would've been at if you weren't so determined.

scene_002a.title: Rise and Shine
scene_002a.narration: It sucks to wake up in a bad mood, but you have some time in the morning

choices.label: Take some time to eat breakfast at home

resource_link.description: Deciding to get sober massively changes your routine, might as well include a good breakfast.

choices.label: Grab Breakfast as the School Cafeteria with your pals

resource_link.description: Getting sober isn't a solitary process and peer support is important, unfortunately sometimes peers also trigger the desire to use.

choices.label: Don't bother eating, you're already nauseous

resource_link.description: It can be hard to stay Determined when your basic needs aren't being met.

choices.label: Screw School, stay home

resource_link.description: Its okay to take the time you need.

choices.label: Get up and go, quickly

resource_link.description: Better late than never.

choices.label: Let your parents know and then go

resource_link.description: At least now your tardy is excused.

scene_003a.title: Classes
scene_003a.narration: You can't seem to focus in class, you'd normally have used multiple times by now.

choices.label: Ask a friend for some gum

resource_link.description: You're able to stick it out for the rest of the class, nice coping skill.

choices.label: Just space out for a bit

resource_link.description: Having given up on paying attention, your mind wanders to your preferred source of dopamine.

choices.label: Go to the Nurse

resource_link.description: The nurse offers you some ibuprofen for your headache, which is a start at least.

scene_003b.title: The Cafeteria
scene_003b.narration: You arrive at the cafeteria to grab breakfast, but some of your friends are already doing more than just eating breakfast.

choices.label: Say hello and excuse yourself to your locker

resource_link.description: Just because you decided to quit doesn't mean your friends did. You still love them but it can be hard to be around them right now.

choices.label: Sit down and hangout

resource_link.description: Hanging out with your friends reminds of what you've done with them in the past.

choices.label: Lean on the wall near them

resource_link.description: You're able to gracefully excuse yourself when the conversation veers into upsetting territory.

scene_003c.title: Mental Health Day?
scene_003c.narration: Skipping school isn't as easy as you had hoped, your mom calls you wanting to know why you're still at home.

choices.label: Explain that you needed to stay home and promise to go tomorrow.
Pretend to be Sick

resource_link.description: You feel really guilty for lying, and staying at home leaves you with nothing to distract yourself with.

choices.label: Tell her you didn't realize you slept in and head to school

scene_006a.title: After Practice
scene_006a.narration: After Coach's speech about staying healthy and determination, you head home.

choices.label: Quietly reflect on your first day sober

resource_link.description: Reflection is a powerful tool for achieving your goals.

choices.label: Think about how hard today was

resource_link.description: Today was hard, but you did it and you can do it again.

choices.label: Make a plan for tomorrow.

resource_link.description: Adjusting your habits and routines can help you stay sober.

scene_004a.title: Lockerroom
scene_004a.narration: While getting ready for practice, some of the others on the team are passing around a vape.

choices.label: Get changed, quickly, and get out of there

resource_link.description: Best to avoid tempting scenarios, although drawing attention from your peers can stress you out.

choices.label: Say you have your own when someone offers it to you

resource_link.description: You avoid being given the vape and no one thinks anything of it.

choices.label: Just do your thing, while scowling and hoping everyone leaves you alone.

resource_link.description: The grouchiness comes naturally to you today, making this an effective tactic.

scene_004b.title: Having a Chat
scene_004b.narration: Your parents want to talk to you about why you stayed home from school today.

choices.label: Tell them you didn't sleep at all last night and had a massive headache

resource_link.description: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.

choices.label: Tell them a little lie about having a project you needed to finish

resource_link.description: They're disappointed, but you're not in serious trouble.

choices.label: Tell them the Truth

resource_link.description: They're not as understanding as you'd hoped. You're grounded for sure.

scene_007.title: Day One of Many
scene_007.narration: One day down, many more to go.

scene_005c.narration: You know you're going to get caught when your mom gets home.

resource_link.description: Just because you relapsed doesn't mean you aren't Determined. You can keep trying.
